text_en: Concerning the Ammonites. Thus says the Lord : Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then has Milcom dispossessed Gad, and his people settled in its towns?
text_cn: 关于阿孟子民：上主这样说：“难道以色列没有子孙，没有后嗣？为什么米耳公占据了加得，而他的人民竟住在加得的城中？

text_en: Therefore, the time is surely coming, says the Lord , when I will sound the battle alarm against Rabbah of the Ammonites; it shall become a desolate mound, and its villages shall be burned with fire; then Israel shall dispossess those who dispossessed him, says the Lord .
text_cn: 为此，看，时日将到──上主的断语──我必使阿孟子民的辣巴听到战争的呐喊；她要成为一堆废墟，她的附属城市要为火烧尽；以色列终归要继承自己的产业──上主说。

text_en: Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste! Cry out, O daughters of Rabbah! Put on sackcloth, lament, and slash yourselves with whips! For Milcom shall go into exile, with his priests and his attendants.
text_cn: 赫市朋，哀号吧！因为破坏者已来近了；辣巴的女郎！你们该哭泣，穿上苦衣哀伤，割伤自己的身体，因为米耳公要与自己的司祭和公卿，同去充军。

text_en: Why do you boast in your strength? Your strength is ebbing, O faithless daughter. You trusted in your treasures, saying, “Who will attack me? ”
text_cn: 失节的女郎！你为什么要夸耀你的山谷是富裕的山谷，仗恃你的宝藏说：‘有谁敢来与我对抗？’

text_en: I am going to bring terror upon you, says the Lord God of hosts, from all your neighbors, and you will be scattered, each headlong, with no one to gather the fugitives.
text_cn: 看，我从各方给你召来恐怖──我主万军上主的断语──你们必被驱逐，各自奔逃，再没有人来聚集逃散的人。

text_en: But afterward I will restore the fortunes of the Ammonites, says the Lord .
text_cn: 虽然如此，日后我仍要转变阿孟子民的命运──上主的断语。”

text_en: Concerning Edom. Thus says the Lord of hosts: Is there no longer wisdom in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished?
text_cn: 关于厄东，万军的上主这样说：“难道在特曼已没有智慧，聪敏的人已计穷才尽了吗？

text_en: Flee, turn back, get down low, inhabitants of Dedan! For I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time when I punish him.
text_cn: 德丹的居民！你们该转身逃遁，藏居深处，因为我要给厄撒乌招来灾祸已到了惩罚他的时候。

text_en: If grape-gatherers came to you, would they not leave gleanings? If thieves came by night, even they would pillage only what they wanted.
text_cn: 如果收葡萄的人来到你这里，决不会留下残余；如果盗贼夜间来袭，必要尽力抢取；

text_en: But as for me, I have stripped Esau bare, I have uncovered his hiding places, and he is not able to conceal himself. His offspring are destroyed, his kinsfolk and his neighbors; and he is no more.
text_cn: 我就要这样暴露厄撒乌，揭发他的隐处，使他无法躲藏；他的后裔，必被消灭，不再存于自己的邻邦中。

text_en: Leave your orphans, I will keep them alive; and let your widows trust in me.
text_cn: 请留下你的孤儿，我必使他们生存，你的寡妇也可托付给我。

text_en: For thus says the Lord : If those who do not deserve to drink the cup still have to drink it, shall you be the one to go unpunished? You shall not go unpunished; you must drink it.
text_cn: 因为上主这样说：看，那原来不该饮苦爵的，一定要饮，你要想完全免罚吗？你决不致于免罚，你也该痛饮！

text_en: For by myself I have sworn, says the Lord , that Bozrah shall become an object of horror and ridicule, a waste, and an object of cursing; and all her towns shall be perpetual wastes.
text_cn: 因为，我曾指自己起誓──上主的断语──波责辣必成为一片荒凉，受人憎恨、侮辱和诅咒；她所有的城市，必要永远变为荒野。

text_en: I have heard tidings from the Lord , and a messenger has been sent among the nations: “Gather yourselves together and come against her, and rise up for battle! ”
text_cn: 我从上主听得了一个消息，在万民间传开了一个号令：“你们该联盟向她进攻！你们该起来交战！”

text_en: For I will make you least among the nations, despised by humankind.
text_cn: 因为，看，我已使你成为万民中最小的，成为人间最可轻贱的。

text_en: The terror you inspire and the pride of your heart have deceived you, you who live in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill. Although you make your nest as high as the eagle’s, from there I will bring you down, says the Lord .
text_cn: 你高居在石缝的隐处，盘据在峻岭的山巅。你自以为惊异，你心内的骄傲欺骗了你。即使你像老鹰一样高结你的巢穴，我也要从那里将你推下──上主的断语。

text_en: Edom shall become an object of horror; everyone who passes by it will be horrified and will hiss because of all its disasters.
text_cn: 厄东必变成荒野，凡由她那里经过的人，见了她的种种惨状，必要唏嘘嗟叹。

text_en: As when Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighbors were overthrown, says the Lord , no one shall live there, nor shall anyone settle in it.
text_cn: 她必要像毁灭的索多玛，哈摩辣及附近的城市一样──上主说──再没有人居住，再没有人在那里寄宿。

text_en: Like a lion coming up from the thickets of the Jordan against a perennial pasture, I will suddenly chase Edom away from it; and I will appoint over it whomever I choose. For who is like me? Who can summon me? Who is the shepherd who can stand before me?
text_cn: 看，好像一只雄狮，从约但的丛林上来，走向常绿的牧场；同样，我也要突然将他们赶走，派我选定的人民来统治。诚然，谁是我的对手？谁敢向我提出质问？谁是能对抗我的牧人？

text_en: Therefore hear the plan that the Lord has made against Edom and the purposes that he has formed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the little ones of the flock shall be dragged away; surely their fold shall be appalled at their fate.
text_cn: 为此，请你们听上主对厄东设计的计谋，对特曼居民策划的策略：连最弱小的羊也要被人牵去，他们的牧场也必陷于战栗中。

text_en: At the sound of their fall the earth shall tremble; the sound of their cry shall be heard at the Red Sea.
text_cn: 他们倒塌的响声，震撼大地；哀号之声，直达红海。

text_en: Look, he shall mount up and swoop down like an eagle, and spread his wings against Bozrah, and the heart of the warriors of Edom in that day shall be like the heart of a woman in labor.
text_cn: 看，他好像老鹰飞升翱翔，在波责辣上展开自己的翅膀；在那一日，厄东的勇士必心志颓丧，有如临产的妇女。

text_en: Concerning Damascus. Hamath and Arpad are confounded, for they have heard bad news; they melt in fear, they are troubled like the sea that cannot be quiet.
text_cn: 关于大马士革：哈玛特和阿尔帕得听到了不好的消息，大起恐慌，像海洋一样动荡，愁苦得不能安宁。

text_en: Damascus has become feeble, she turned to flee, and panic seized her; anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in labor.
text_cn: 大马士革失去勇气，转身逃遁，极感战栗，备受忧虑痛苦，好像一临产的妇女。

text_en: How the famous city is forsaken, the joyful town!
text_cn: 哀哉，有名的城邑，享乐的都市，已被摒(bìng)弃！

text_en: Therefore her young men shall fall in her squares, and all her soldiers shall be destroyed in that day, says the Lord of hosts.
text_cn: 她的少年将倒毙在广场，她的战士在那一日内要悉数灭亡──万军上主的断语──

text_en: And I will kindle a fire at the wall of Damascus, and it shall devour the strongholds of Ben-hadad.
text_cn: 我必在大马士革城墙上放火，吞灭本哈达得的宫阙。

text_en: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor that King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon defeated. Thus says the Lord : Rise up, advance against Kedar! Destroy the people of the east!
text_cn: 关于刻达尔和巴比伦王拿步高克服了的哈祚（zuò）尔诸国，上主这样说：“起来！进攻刻达尔，蹂躝（lìn）东方子民！

text_en: Take their tents and their flocks, their curtains and all their goods; carry off their camels for yourselves, and a cry shall go up: “Terror is all around! ”
text_cn: 夺取他们的帐幕和牲畜，帷幔和所有的器具；牵走他们的骆驼，向他们呐喊：四面恐怖。

text_en: Flee, wander far away, hide in deep places, O inhabitants of Hazor! says the Lord . For King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon has made a plan against you and formed a purpose against you.
text_cn: 哈祚尔的居民！你们应逃遁远去，藏匿深处──上主的断语──因为巴比伦王拿步高已设计谋害你们，已策划攻击你们。

text_en: Rise up, advance against a nation at ease, that lives secure, says the Lord , that has no gates or bars, that lives alone.
text_cn: 起来，进攻优游闲居，不设门闩(shuān)，孑（jié）然独居的民族──上主的断语──

text_en: Their camels shall become booty, their herds of cattle a spoil. I will scatter to every wind those who have shaven temples, and I will bring calamity against them from every side, says the Lord .
text_cn: 抢夺他们的骆驼，劫掠他们成群的牲畜；凡剃去鬓发的，我必叫他们随风飘散，由四面八方给他们招来灾祸──上主的断语──

text_en: Hazor shall become a lair of jackals, an everlasting waste; no one shall live there, nor shall anyone settle in it.
text_cn: 哈祚尔要变为豺狼的巢穴，永远荒凉，不会留下一人，不会再有人居住。”

text_en: The word of the Lord that came to the prophet Jeremiah concerning Elam, at the beginning of the reign of King Zedekiah of Judah.
text_cn: 犹大王漆德克雅初年，关于厄蓝有上主的话传给耶肋米亚先知说：

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: I am going to break the bow of Elam, the mainstay of their might;
text_cn: “万军的上主这样说：看，我要折断厄蓝的弓弩，称雄的势力；

text_en: and I will bring upon Elam the four winds from the four quarters of heaven; and I will scatter them to all these winds, and there shall be no nation to which the exiles from Elam shall not come.
text_cn: 我要从天下四面八方，给厄蓝召来四方的风，使他们随风飘散，以致没有一个民族，没有厄蓝的难民。

text_en: I will terrify Elam before their enemies, and before those who seek their life; I will bring disaster upon them, my fierce anger, says the Lord . I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them;
text_cn: 我必使厄蓝在自己的仇敌，和图谋自己性命的人前，惊惶失措；给他们招来灾祸，我忿怒的火焰──上主的断语──派出刀剑追迫他们，直至将他们完全消灭。

text_en: and I will set my throne in Elam, and destroy their king and officials, says the Lord .
text_cn: 我必在厄蓝设立我的宝座，歼灭其中的君王将帅──上主的断语──

text_en: But in the latter days I will restore the fortunes of Elam, says the Lord .
text_cn: 虽然如此，在末日我仍要转变厄蓝的命运──上主的断语。”
